finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹500 Cr, EBITDA margin = 25%, Debt = ₹600 Cr, Interest rate = 10%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹125 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹60 Cr = ₹65 Cr.
New revenue = ₹450 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹112 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹52 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-12 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
